input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions. If named-insured ownership remains unresolved, use property_ownership in missing_fields; it means clarify whether the named insured owns the item alone or jointly, rather than inferring ownership from shared use or payments.

messages.text: There was a fire in our apartment on October 5. The projector we use for film nights burned. Can I include it under my personal-property coverage?
It has always been in our shared living room. My roommate arranged to get it, and I paid them money around that time, but I do not remember whether that was my share of buying it or just rent.

event_date.description: Reported event date in ISO format.

owned_by_named_insured.description: True if named-insured ownership is established, false if explicitly absent, otherwise null.

property_scope.description: Scope conclusion for the projector from supplied evidence.
